notes.title: "Art Reborn" is adapted into a board game!
notes.content:
The new board game "Art Reborn: Appraisal Expert" is coming!

Recently, our game "Art Reborn" has been linked with "Appraisal Company" to release a board game "Art Reborn: Appraisal Expert"! ! !

Hello everyone and good afternoon! Haven’t released any new news for a long time! Let’s play big this time!

Recently, our game "Art Reborn" has been linked with "Appraisal Company" to release a board game "Art Reborn: Appraisal Expert"! ! !

Now "Art Reborn: Appraisal Company" has started crowdfunding on Modian! Officially opens on December 8th!

 Modian：https://zhongchou.modian.com/item/129825.html?utm_source=Appshare&utm_content=1003821774

Buy the game "Art Reborn" + "Art Reborn: Appraisal Expert" board game now with full discounts!

Digital file:
1 box of board game "Art Reborn: Appraisal Expert" + 1 steam code for the video game "Art Reborn", 1 box set, free shipping in non-remote areas.

The game "Art Reborn" has been released for some time! Thank you very much for your support and companionship. I also hope to make something different in this collaboration with "Appraisal Company".

This board game is easy to play, brain-burning and fun. It allows players who have never been exposed to board games to get started easily!

The board game supports 3-5 people and the game lasts about 30 minutes. New famous painting cards have been added to the board game, and a famous painting appreciation book will be given with the board game, as well as exquisite firmness certificate marks, etc.!

notes.title: "Art Reborn（Painting Connoisseur）" Officially Released!
notes.content:
Hello friends! The wait is finally over! [b]"Art Reborn（Painting Connoisseur）" is now available on Steam![/b]

In addition, our thoughtful development team has prepared a special DLC for you called "Art Reborn（Painting Connoisseur）- The muse（Player Assistance）", which is also released today!

----Pricing Details---- 
• The game is priced at $6.99, but during the first week of release, it's discounted to $6.29. The DLC is priced at $0.99. 
• For the first week, we offer a bundle of the "Art Reborn Base Game + DLC" at a 15% discount.
• Moreover, we have an amazing bundle offer of "Dr. Chatelet: Faith + Art Reborn" for the first week. Players who have already purchased "Dr. Chatelet: Faith" on Steam can avail of an additional discount.

After countless days and nights of effort, the official version of "Art Reborn" is now live. We have so much to say, but to keep it short, we hope every player gains something from this game and feels the message we want to convey!
Lastly, a heartfelt thank you to every supportive player, media outlet, and fellow developer.

Explore Western aesthetics, appreciate world-famous paintings, and enjoy your gameplay!
Should players encounter any issues during gameplay, please leave a comment below or join our [b]official QQ group: 636212165[/b] to provide feedback.

notes.title: Launching on Steam on August 17th!
notes.content:
Dear Curators,
Thank you for your unwavering support and patience. "Art Reborn（Painting Connoisseur）" has finally set its release date!

[u][b]It will officially launch on Steam at 10:00 AM Beijing time on August 17th, 2023.[/b][/u]

[u][b]The game is priced at 38 yuan, with a 10% discount during its first week![/b][/u]

The art education and nurturing game "Art Reborn（Painting Connoisseur）" full version is about to be released on Steam, with an estimated playtime of around 5 hours. A demo version is currently available for download on Steam. [b][u]We encourage all curators to add "Art Reborn（Painting Connoisseur）" to your wishlist![/u][/b]

Since the launch of our demo version last year, we've received a lot of feedback from many of you. Your love and passion for "Art Reborn（Painting Connoisseur）" have both delighted and pressured us. As the first commercial project of our studio, your appreciation has given us immense encouragement, further cementing our determination to press on! At present, the official version of "Art Reborn（Painting Connoisseur）" is in its final sprint. We hope that through this game, every player can be both educated and healed.

Thank you to all the friends who have been supporting Muccy Games. Your love and passion are the driving forces that keep us going. In the future, we will remain true to our original aspiration, continue our commitment to education and produce even more high-quality projects for everyone. Stay tuned!

notes.content:

November 18, 12:00– November 30, 24:00

[How to participate]
Curators can post reviews of [b][i]Art Reborn[/i][/b] on the game's page, and gifts will then be sent to the top five people based on the number of recommendations from the reviews.

notes.title: Art Reborn(Painting Connoisseur) Demo On
notes.content: Curators, welcome to this year's Art Exhibition! The exhibition is opening on November 18th at 10:00! In a world full of famous paintings and artworks, you will take on the role of a curator, using the charm of painting art to convince one audience after another and enchant them with the charm of painting art! During your journey, you will be able to take in the world's most familiar paintings and fill your pavilion with them!
